goal.instructions: Choose the goal whose prerequisites match the current measurements. Apply the fixed definitions in the options. uncollectedYellowEdges counts yellow edges that are neither yellow-up petals nor solved bottom edges. PreviousGoal is memory, not an instruction; choose using present conditions. Completion flags describe structures, not recommendations. The program stops separately when all pieces are solved.

criteria.daisy: Gather yellow edges as top petals. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges>0. Preserve solved bottom edges and existing petals.
criteria.cross: Transfer yellow-up petals to their bottom homes. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges=0. This controller only transfers petals; it cannot extract or gather missing petals.
criteria.top-cross: Orient white top edges. Choose when middle=true and topCross=false.
criteria.top-orientation: Orient white top corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true and topOriented=false.
criteria.top-corners: Place or align white corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true and cornersPlaced=false.
criteria.top-edges: Place or align remaining white edges. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true, cornersPlaced=true and solved=false.
criteria.f2l: Solve the four yellow-corner/middle-edge pairs together. Choose when completed.cross=true and completed.middle=false. Preserve the completed cross and already solved pairs.

frame.note: Fixed frame: yellow D, white U. Clockwise is viewed directly at the turned face. Camera has no effect.

edges: Edge DF is at DB. yellow faces D; green faces B.
Edge DR is at DL. yellow faces D; red faces L.
Edge DB is at BL. yellow faces B; blue faces L.
Edge DL is at BR. yellow faces R; orange faces B.

gatherTarget.instructions: Assume the goal is gathering missing petals, regardless of the goal answer in this request. Choose an edge with petal=no AND bottom=no. Preserve both existing petals and solved bottom edges. Prefer an accessible edge; any eligible edge is allowed. If none is eligible, choose none.

criteria.none: No eligible edge for this hypothetical goal

transferTarget.instructions: Assume the goal is transferring petals, regardless of the goal answer in this request. Choose an edge with petal=yes AND bottom=no. Any eligible petal is allowed. If none is eligible, choose none.

criteria.none: No eligible edge for this hypothetical goal

situation.instructions: Classify this selected edge using ONLY currentPosition and yellowDirection. First check yellowDirection=U (petal). Otherwise currentPosition starting D is bottom; starting U is top; all other edge positions are middle. The piece identity is deliberately omitted.

criteria.bottomDown: Edge is on D and yellow faces D
criteria.bottomSide: Edge is on D and yellow faces a side
criteria.middle: Edge is between side faces, not on U or D
criteria.topSide: Edge is on U and yellow faces a side

reference.instructions: Choose the reference front. If yellowDirection is F/R/B/L, choose that face. If yellowDirection is U or D, choose the other letter of currentPosition. Use current position only.

routine.instructions: Choose a routine whose position AND yellow direction match the current target, with no affectedBottomSlot in protectedBottomSlots. Ignore landing occupancy for now. Prefer a lift over staging initially. If a previous routine was rejected by the model, choose a different matching routine, including a staging routine. Do not repeat a rejected routine.

situation.instructions: Classify this selected edge using ONLY currentPosition and yellowDirection. First check yellowDirection=U (petal). Otherwise currentPosition starting D is bottom; starting U is top; all other edge positions are middle. The piece identity is deliberately omitted.

criteria.bottomDown: Edge is on D and yellow faces D
criteria.bottomSide: Edge is on D and yellow faces a side
criteria.middle: Edge is between side faces, not on U or D
criteria.topSide: Edge is on U and yellow faces a side

reference.instructions: Choose the reference front. If yellowDirection is F/R/B/L, choose that face. If yellowDirection is U or D, choose the other letter of currentPosition. Use current position only.

state.frame: Local reference front=L; U and D stay fixed. Occupied means a yellow-up petal, not just any edge.

decision.instructions: The target is a yellow-up petal. Before transferring it with the selected half-turn, its side sticker must match the adjacent side center. If sideMatchesCenter is true choose insert. Otherwise choose align. Decide the next intention only; do not select a turn.

goal.instructions: Choose the goal whose prerequisites match the current measurements. Apply the fixed definitions in the options. uncollectedYellowEdges counts yellow edges that are neither yellow-up petals nor solved bottom edges. PreviousGoal is memory, not an instruction; choose using present conditions. Completion flags describe structures, not recommendations. The program stops separately when all pieces are solved.

criteria.daisy: Gather yellow edges as top petals. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges>0. Preserve solved bottom edges and existing petals.
criteria.cross: Transfer yellow-up petals to their bottom homes. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges=0. This controller only transfers petals; it cannot extract or gather missing petals.
criteria.top-cross: Orient white top edges. Choose when middle=true and topCross=false.
criteria.top-orientation: Orient white top corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true and topOriented=false.
criteria.top-corners: Place or align white corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true and cornersPlaced=false.
criteria.top-edges: Place or align remaining white edges. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true, cornersPlaced=true and solved=false.
criteria.f2l: Solve the four yellow-corner/middle-edge pairs together. Choose when completed.cross=true and completed.middle=false. Preserve the completed cross and already solved pairs.

target.instructions: Choose an unfinished corner/edge pair to solve together, preserving the cross and completed pairs. Continue previousTarget until both pieces are solved. Otherwise prefer pieces already in the upper layer. Each ID is a home slot, not a current location. Choose done only when every listed corner and edge is solved.

criteria.FR: Work on pair FR, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.BR: Work on pair BR, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.BL: Work on pair BL, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.FL: Work on pair FL, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.done: All four pairs have both corner.solved=true and edge.solved=true.

front.instructions: Choose a notation reference that puts this pair HOME at local front-right. This changes notation only, not the cube. Use homeSlot, not its current position.

preparation.instructions: Choose how to prepare the selected pair for its learned F2L reference. First free any target piece trapped in a different bottom/middle slot. Preserve completed slots. With both targets in the upper layer or their own slot, use the canonical reference positions in these options.

criteria.extract-corner: Corner is in a bottom position other than DRF. Lift it from its CURRENT slot.
criteria.extract-edge: Corner is upper or DRF, but edge is in a middle position other than FR. Lift the edge from its CURRENT slot.
criteria.align-corner: Corner is upper but not UFR, and edge is upper or FR. Rotate U so the corner reaches UFR.
criteria.align-edge: Corner is DRF and edge is upper but not UF. Rotate U so the edge reaches UF.
criteria.routine: Corner is UFR and edge is upper or FR; OR corner is DRF and edge is UF or FR. The pair is prepared for a learned routine.
criteria.reconsider: None of these reference domains applies.

extraction.instructions: Choose the slot-opening routine that lifts the target from its CURRENT position. These routines restore the cross and the other three pair slots. Only the opened slot is disturbed. Coordinates are in the selected local frame.

criteria.B: Opens local slot BL and bottom corner DLB. Execute L U L'.
criteria.L: Opens local slot FL and bottom corner DFL. Execute F U F'.

criteria.extract-corner: Corner is in a bottom position other than DRF. Lift it from its CURRENT slot.
criteria.extract-edge: Corner is upper or DRF, but edge is in a middle position other than FR. Lift the edge from its CURRENT slot.
criteria.align-corner: Corner is upper but not UFR, and edge is upper or FR. Rotate U so the corner reaches UFR.
criteria.align-edge: Corner is DRF and edge is upper but not UF. Rotate U so the edge reaches UF.
criteria.routine: Corner is UFR and edge is upper or FR; OR corner is DRF and edge is UF or FR. The pair is prepared for a learned routine.
criteria.reconsider: None of these reference domains applies.

state.frame: Local front F, right R, down D. Target pair belongs at DRF corner and FR edge.

routine.instructions: Choose a learned F2L routine whose reference illustration matches BOTH observed pieces: their current positions and sticker directions. Read current position, not the destination slot. These routines solve this corner and edge together, preserving the cross and other three pairs. Do not simulate candidate outcomes. If no reference matches choose reconsider.

goal.instructions: Choose the goal whose prerequisites match the current measurements. Apply the fixed definitions in the options. uncollectedYellowEdges counts yellow edges that are neither yellow-up petals nor solved bottom edges. PreviousGoal is memory, not an instruction; choose using present conditions. Completion flags describe structures, not recommendations. The program stops separately when all pieces are solved.

criteria.daisy: Gather yellow edges as top petals. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges>0. Preserve solved bottom edges and existing petals.
criteria.cross: Transfer yellow-up petals to their bottom homes. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges=0. This controller only transfers petals; it cannot extract or gather missing petals.
criteria.top-cross: Orient white top edges. Choose when middle=true and topCross=false.
criteria.top-orientation: Orient white top corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true and topOriented=false.
criteria.top-corners: Place or align white corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true and cornersPlaced=false.
criteria.top-edges: Place or align remaining white edges. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true, cornersPlaced=true and solved=false.
criteria.f2l: Solve the four yellow-corner/middle-edge pairs together. Choose when completed.cross=true and completed.middle=false. Preserve the completed cross and already solved pairs.

target.instructions: Choose an unfinished corner/edge pair to solve together, preserving the cross and completed pairs. Continue previousTarget until both pieces are solved. Otherwise prefer pieces already in the upper layer. Each ID is a home slot, not a current location. Choose done only when every listed corner and edge is solved.

criteria.FR: Work on pair FR, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.BR: Work on pair BR, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.BL: Work on pair BL, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.FL: Work on pair FL, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.done: All four pairs have both corner.solved=true and edge.solved=true.

front.instructions: Choose a notation reference that puts this pair HOME at local front-right. This changes notation only, not the cube. Use homeSlot, not its current position.

turn.instructions: Choose the U turn carrying currentPosition to requiredPosition using the generic position cycles. Choose one rotation, not a routine.

With both targets in the upper layer or their own slot, use the canonical reference positions in these options.

criteria.extract-corner: Corner is in a bottom position other than DRF. Lift it from its CURRENT slot.
criteria.extract-edge: Corner is upper or DRF, but edge is in a middle position other than FR. Lift the edge from its CURRENT slot.
criteria.align-corner: Corner is upper but not UFR, and edge is upper or FR. Rotate U so the corner reaches UFR.
criteria.align-edge: Corner is DRF and edge is upper but not UF. Rotate U so the edge reaches UF.
criteria.routine: Corner is UFR and edge is upper or FR; OR corner is DRF and edge is UF or FR. The pair is prepared for a learned routine.
criteria.reconsider: None of these reference domains applies.

turn.instructions: Choose the U turn carrying currentPosition to requiredPosition using the generic position cycles. Choose one rotation, not a routine.

criteria.U: Upper edges UF→UL→UB→UR→UF; upper corners UFR→ULF→UBL→URB→UFR.
criteria.U': Upper edges UF→UR→UB→UL→UF; upper corners UFR→URB→UBL→ULF→UFR.
criteria.U2: Upper edges UF/UB and UR/UL exchange; upper corners UFR/UBL and URB/ULF exchange.
criteria.reconsider: No U rotation is needed or these positions cannot be related by U.

goal.instructions: Choose the goal whose prerequisites match the current measurements. Apply the fixed definitions in the options. uncollectedYellowEdges counts yellow edges that are neither yellow-up petals nor solved bottom edges. PreviousGoal is memory, not an instruction; choose using present conditions. Completion flags describe structures, not recommendations. The program stops separately when all pieces are solved.

criteria.daisy: Gather yellow edges as top petals. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges>0. Preserve solved bottom edges and existing petals.
criteria.cross: Transfer yellow-up petals to their bottom homes. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges=0. This controller only transfers petals; it cannot extract or gather missing petals.
criteria.top-cross: Orient white top edges. Choose when middle=true and topCross=false.
criteria.top-orientation: Orient white top corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true and topOriented=false.
criteria.top-corners: Place or align white corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true and cornersPlaced=false.
criteria.top-edges: Place or align remaining white edges. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true, cornersPlaced=true and solved=false.
criteria.f2l: Solve the four yellow-corner/middle-edge pairs together. Choose when completed.cross=true and completed.middle=false. Preserve the completed cross and already solved pairs.

situation.instructions: Classify this selected edge using ONLY currentPosition and yellowDirection. First check yellowDirection=U (petal). Otherwise currentPosition starting D is bottom; starting U is top; all other edge positions are middle. The piece identity is deliberately omitted.

criteria.bottomDown: Edge is on D and yellow faces D
criteria.bottomSide: Edge is on D and yellow faces a side
criteria.middle: Edge is between side faces, not on U or D
criteria.topSide: Edge is on U and yellow faces a side

reference.instructions: Choose the reference front. If yellowDirection is F/R/B/L, choose that face. If yellowDirection is U or D, choose the other letter of currentPosition. Use current position only.

plan.instructions: Decide whether to resume the remembered routine. Compare current against pending. Resume requires ALL: same target; same front; current.position equals pending.startingPosition; same yellowDirection; no pending.affectedBottomSlots occurs in current.protectedBottomSlots. Ignore routine names when checking these requirements. Resume explicitly selects that previous routine; a later question checks landing occupancy. Otherwise reconsider and choose a new routine.

criteria.resume: Every starting and preservation requirement matches; choose the remembered routine again.
criteria.reconsider: At least one requirement fails; discard the remembered routine.

state.frame: Local reference front=R; U and D stay fixed. Occupied means a yellow-up petal, not just any edge.

decision.instructions: The model already selected a lift from the fixed routine reference. Inspect only selectedRoutine.requiredFreeSlots. If none of those slots contains a yellow-up petal, choose execute. Otherwise, if target.layer is bottom or middle choose clear. If a required slot is occupied and target.layer is top choose lower, because rotating U would move this target too. Other occupied slots do not matter.

criteria.clear: Clear a landing slot with a top setup first
criteria.lower: Lower the top target before making space

goal.instructions: Choose the goal whose prerequisites match the current measurements. Apply the fixed definitions in the options. uncollectedYellowEdges counts yellow edges that are neither yellow-up petals nor solved bottom edges. criteria.daisy: Gather yellow edges as top petals. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges>0. Preserve solved bottom edges and existing petals.
criteria.cross: Transfer yellow-up petals to their bottom homes. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges=0. This controller only transfers petals; it cannot extract or gather missing petals.
criteria.top-cross: Orient white top edges. Choose when middle=true and topCross=false.
criteria.top-orientation: Orient white top corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true and topOriented=false.
criteria.top-corners: Place or align white corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true and cornersPlaced=false.
criteria.top-edges: Place or align remaining white edges. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true, cornersPlaced=true and solved=false.
criteria.f2l: Solve the four yellow-corner/middle-edge pairs together. Choose when completed.cross=true and completed.middle=false. Preserve the completed cross and already solved pairs.

frame.note: Fixed frame: yellow D, white U. Clockwise is viewed directly at the turned face. Camera has no effect.

edges: Edge DF is at UL. yellow faces U; green faces L.
Edge DR is at BL. yellow faces B; red faces L.
Edge DB is at FL. yellow faces L; blue faces F.
Edge DL is at FR. yellow faces R; orange faces F.

criteria.top-edges: Place or align remaining white edges. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true, cornersPlaced=true and solved=false.
criteria.f2l: Solve the four yellow-corner/middle-edge pairs together. Choose when completed.cross=true and completed.middle=false. Preserve the completed cross and already solved pairs.

target.instructions: Choose an unfinished corner/edge pair to solve together, preserving the cross and completed pairs. Continue previousTarget until both pieces are solved. Otherwise prefer pieces already in the upper layer. Each ID is a home slot, not a current location. Choose done only when every listed corner and edge is solved.

criteria.FR: Work on pair FR, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.BR: Work on pair BR, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.BL: Work on pair BL, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.FL: Work on pair FL, if its corner or edge is not solved.
criteria.done: All four pairs have both corner.solved=true and edge.solved=true.

front.instructions: Choose a notation reference that puts this pair HOME at local front-right. This changes notation only, not the cube. Use homeSlot, not its current position.

preparation.instructions: Choose how to prepare the selected pair for its learned F2L reference. First free any target piece trapped in a different bottom/middle slot. Preserve completed slots. With both targets in the upper layer or their own slot, use the canonical reference positions in these options.

criteria.extract-corner: Corner is in a bottom position other than DRF. Lift it from its CURRENT slot.
criteria.extract-edge: Corner is upper or DRF, but edge is in a middle position other than FR. Lift the edge from its CURRENT slot.
criteria.align-corner: Corner is upper but not UFR, and edge is upper or FR. Rotate U so the corner reaches UFR.
criteria.align-edge: Corner is DRF and edge is upper but not UF. Rotate U so the edge reaches UF.
criteria.routine: Corner is UFR and edge is upper or FR; OR corner is DRF and edge is UF or FR. The pair is prepared for a learned routine.
criteria.reconsider: None of these reference domains applies.

turn.instructions: Choose the U turn carrying currentPosition to requiredPosition using the generic position cycles. Choose one rotation, not a routine.

criteria.U: Upper edges UF→UL→UB→UR→UF; upper corners UFR→ULF→UBL→URB→UFR.
criteria.U': Upper edges UF→UR→UB→UL→UF; upper corners UFR→URB→UBL→ULF→UFR.
criteria.U2: Upper edges UF/UB and UR/UL exchange; upper corners UFR/UBL and URB/ULF exchange.
criteria.reconsider: No U rotation is needed or these positions cannot be related by U.

goal.instructions: Choose the goal whose prerequisites match the current measurements. PreviousGoal is memory, not an instruction; choose using present conditions. Completion flags describe structures, not recommendations. The program stops separately when all pieces are solved.
